record.question: Living at the same time as another
record.explanation: Answer A: contemporary. A contemporary is a person living at the same time as another; generation and era name a group/time period rather than that relationship. Original paper prints three choices; the empty imported fourth slot was removed after visual source inspection. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no examiner key is asserted.
